name: TC-085: Dashboard auto-refreshes every 60 seconds when auto-refresh is enabled
description: Verifies the 60-second auto-refresh cycle defined by AUTO_REFRESH_MS = 60_000 in traffic-dashboard.ts. The component uses interval(60_000).pipe(startWith(0)) which triggers loadAllData() every 60 seconds. The visible proof of a refresh is the 'Updated HH:MM:SS' timestamp (.last-refreshed) updating to a new value. Strategy: (1) ensure auto-refresh is active, (2) read the current timestamp, (3) wait 65 seconds (60s interval + 5s buffer for API calls), (4) assert the timestamp changed, meaning a new refresh cycle completed.
